name: image_adjudication_obd_agent
functionality: Compares Catalog Image against OBD (Open Box Delivery) Images to verify product identity, detect damage, and check for missing items at the time of delivery. Uses the same multi-phase framework as cx_agent but applied to delivery-time photographs taken by the delivery agent. Confirms what was actually delivered matches what was ordered.
inputs: obd_images (1-3 delivery images), product_image (catalog), return_reason, return_sub_reason, vertical
promptDescription: Uses same FK_PROMPT variants as image_adjudication_cx_agent (FK_PROMPT_1 v3.0, FK_PROMPT_2, FK_PROMPT_3, FK_PROMPT_4). Applied to OBD (delivery-time) images instead of customer images. Same 5-Phase framework: Can't Say Firewall -> Misshipment (5 Pillars) -> Damage -> Missing -> No Issue. Aggregation logic applies across multiple OBD images.
